title: When the Inheritance Wakes Revisited
author: Emrys Vane
blurb: Jonah Amberdale, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
